# Rosalind Penrose

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five in Volume 1, forty-six in Volume 2, and forty-eight in Volume 4.  <sub>[v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v4 c21 P44](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v1 c29 P4](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0004), [v1 c30 P12](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0012)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c19 P53](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0053)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v1 c19 P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v2 c21 P14](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0014)</sub>; Mrs. Stanhope  <sub>[v1 c30 P12](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosalind is a slender, tiny woman with rosy cheeks, sweet lips, and wood-brown eyes containing flecks of gold. She has dimples and a fair, youthful face beneath her thick, wavy, snow-white hair, which she styles in flattering puffs and coils. She often wears frilly, delicate cream or pale organdy dresses decorated with roses.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c33 P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)_

## Personality

Rosalind is a youthful, imaginative, and affectionate spirit who enjoys fantasy, romance, and good humor. Though occasionally moody or stubborn, she has a kind, generous nature and takes great pleasure in pretending, decorating, and entertaining. She is deeply attached to her old memories, her garden, and her home, and values genuine, understanding friendships.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088), [v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092), [v1 c19 P97](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0097), [v1 c23 P19](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0019), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P56](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0056), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Rosalind Penrose lived for many years as a solitary spinster at Echo Cottage in Middle Welby, tending a beautiful garden and entertaining herself with imaginative games, echoes, and a series of young hired girls whom she collectively called Belinda. In her youth, she had been engaged to Stephen Stanhope, but a bitter quarrel caused by pride and moodiness broke their engagement, leading Stephen to leave for the United States. In Volume 1, Nell Harcourt accidentally discovered Rosalind after jumping onto the spare-room bed during a night out, and the two formed an immediate bond as kindred spirits. In Volume 2, after learning that Posy Fay was saved from croup by Nell, Rosalind's cousin's family made peace with the Grey Shutters household, and Rosalind continued to host Nell, Isolde, and later young Cedric Stanhope, Stephen's son. Through Nell's secret letter, Stephen learned that Rosalind was still unmarried, leading to his return and their joyful reconciliation. The two were married under the honeysuckle arbor at Echo Cottage before leaving on a honeymoon trip to the Pacific coast. They later settled in Boston during the winter months while returning to Echo Cottage every summer.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c19 P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P19](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0019), [v1 c29 P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 c30 P12](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0012), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in East Welby where her father named her for his love of lavender
- Was betrothed in her youth to Stephen Stanhope before a misunderstanding separated them  <sub>[v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P19](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Lived for decades as a solitary spinster in the sandstone cottage called Echo Cottage  <sub>[v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>
- Employed a succession of young handmaidens named Belinda  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
